codex_two_window_policy: Add the received limited closure evidence to claimed_fixed; do not automatically promote to verified
application_condition: Claude confirms candidate import identity and receipt completeness, then records the scoped disposition and returns a mapping note

items.scope: Raw signed reaction, normalization of the same frozen sample with explicit polarity, wrong-sign rejection before control
items.excluded: Actual T0 polarity and engine syntax or runtime qualification

items.scope: First-window hit separated from completed budget, final window and pending delay queue checks
items.excluded: Infinite-horizon, later-than-budget or actual physical-bed stability

items.scope: Symmetric geometric intersection-circle arithmetic on exact received inputs, explicit unrepresentable output rejection
items.excluded: Physical contact/electrical area model or tolerance choice

items.scope: Translation-invariant penetration decision when geometry supplied to the function is preserved
items.excluded: Input information already lost to float rounding, STL/PBC or continuous trajectory qualification

earlier_proposals: Preserved as historical pending records; this receipt supplies later scoped independent evidence without editing them

scientific_registration.meaning: Complete registered qualifications not performed; not a claim of zero unit tests
